purpose: Teach: 印紙/新法/極論/由緒/疑義/客員/総評/携え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、印紙税を自ら管理された
lines.en: Father managed the stamp tax himself from the very beginning.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Quiet pride in the detail. Long, knowing pause before the statement — the voice of someone remembering someone no longer here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新法に迅速に対応された
lines.en: Yes. He adapted quickly to the new regulations.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady, direct. Not defensive — simply confirming what was true. The respect of one who understands what that swiftness required.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、極論を避けてバランスを取られた
lines.en: He avoided extremes and held the middle ground.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. The tone of someone reflecting on a principle that shaped a life. Slight wistfulness — as if saying 'that was harder than it sounds.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは由緒ある会社を誇りにされた
lines.en: Yes. He took pride in the legacy of the company itself.
lines.style: Thoughtful, settling into memory. Warm undertone. The words come deliberate, careful — honoring what was built and how it was held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、株主の疑義に正直に答えられた
lines.en: He answered shareholders' doubts with honesty, even when it was difficult.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The voice pauses slightly before 'honestly' — emphasizing that directness came at a cost. Wistful edge: the rarity of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは大学の客員教授も務められた
lines.en: Yes. He also served as a guest professor at the university.
lines.style: Adding another thread to the portrait. Calm, factual, but with the warmth of someone noticing how much one person could hold. No strain in the voice — just witness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の総評で常に高評価だった
lines.en: In industry reviews, he was always highly regarded.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact, but spoken with the weight of knowing it's true. The tone of someone who watched others' respect accumulate over time. Slight fadeout — letting the truth settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業の志を携えて経営された
lines.en: Yes. He carried the vision of the founding into everything he did.
lines.style: Closing statement. Slower pace, grounded. The voice reaches a kind of peace here — not resignation, but acceptance. As if saying: this is what it meant. This is what remains.
